ov: السبعة الرئعون (الإنجليزية: The Magnificent Seven) هو فيلم من أفلام الغرب الأمريكي (وسترن) يحكي قصة مزارعين مكسيكيين يتعرضون للاستغلال من قبل زعيم عصابة يدعى كالبيرا (إلي ولاك)، فيذهبون لطلب المساعدة من رماة أمريكيين مهرة. الفيلم مأخوذ عن قصة فيلم ياباني اسمه «الساموراي السبعة» (الإنجليزية: Seven Samurai) عام 1954، أما فيلم السبعة الرائعون فقد استوحيت منه قصة فيلم حياة حشرة عام 1998 وتم إقتباسه وإنتاجه في مصر باسم شمس الزناتي.
plotEn:
An impoverished Mexican village is repeatedly raided for food and supplies by a gang of bandits led by Calvera. After Calvera kills a villager during one of these raids, the leaders consult an elder living as a hermit outside the village. He advises them to arm themselves and fight back. Three villagers are despatched with their few objects of value to try to barter for weapons. In a town just inside the United States, the villagers approach gunslinger Chris Adams who advises them to hire gunfighters, because "men are cheaper than guns."
Chris finds five willing gunmen: Vin Tanner, a gunfighter broke from gambling; Chris' friend Harry Luck, who assumes Chris is hiding a much bigger reward for the work; the Irish Mexican Bernardo O'Reilly, who has fallen on hard times; Britt, a marksman and expert knife fighter attracted by the challenges they'll face; and the dapper, on-the-run gunman Lee, plagued by nightmares of fallen enemies and no longer eager for battle. The group is followed back to the village by the hotheaded Chico, an aspiring gunfighter whose previous attempts to join Chris had been spurned. Impressed by his persistence, Chris allows him into the group. The gunfighters help the villagers build fortifications and train them for combat, puzzled by the absence of young women.
